case_title.quote: CHOTKAU v. STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: the sole accused has come up with the above appeals

accused_gender.reason: Accused is referred to as male throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age for the accused appears anywhere in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: Religion of the accused is not stated in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste of the accused is not stated.

accused_occupation.reason: Accused's occupation is not stated; labourer reference concerns his brothers.

accused_socioeconomic_status.correct_value: Poor; could not afford to engage a lawyer in the Sessions Court
accused_socioeconomic_status.quote: the appellant is so poor that he could not afford to engage a lawyer even in the Sessions Court
accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: The judgment expressly states the appellant was poor and was provided an amicus.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No previous criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: took his niece aged about 6 years
victim_gender.reason: Victim is a girl, consistently described as female.

victim_age.reason: Judgment states the victim was about six years old.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: took his niece aged about 6 years
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Accused was the victim's uncle-level relative (niece), i.e., a relative.

offence_category.quote: charged for the commission of the offences of raping the minor girl and murdering her
offence_category.reason: Category omits the rape offence; both rape and murder were charged and are central.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 302 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
statutory_provisions.reason: Matches the convicting provisions cited in the judgment.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: the prosecution of the appellant is based on circumstantial evidence
evidence_type.reason: Judgment explicitly says the case rests on circumstantial evidence.

confession.reason: No confession by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.correct_value: Six-year-old victim; rarest of rare case; deviant behaviour and abnormal sexual urge (per courts below)
aggravating_circumstances.quote: one of the rarest of rare cases where a six year old girl had been raped and murdered
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Judgment records aggravating findings made by the lower courts, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are recorded as such in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: sentenced to death by the Sessions Court
trial_court_outcome.reason: Sessions Court convicted and imposed death sentence.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court confirmed conviction and death sentence on reference and appeal.

final_outcome.quote: the appeals are allowed and the conviction and penalty are set aside
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court set aside conviction and sentence, effectively acquitting the appellant.

offence_finally_established.quote: we are not convinced that the guilt of the appellant stood established beyond reasonable doubt
offence_finally_established.reason: No offence was finally established given the acquittal.

imprisonment_type.reason: No imprisonment sentence survives; none stated.

neutral_facts.reason: Facts match the judgment and do not reveal the Supreme Court outcome.

offence_severity.quote: sentenced to death by the Sessions Court
offence_severity.reason: No minimum or maximum prison terms are stated; only the death sentence is mentioned.

attempt_completion.quote: the offences of raping the minor girl and murdering her
attempt_completion.reason: Rape and murder are described as committed, implying completed offences.

physical_harm.quote: the dead body of the girl was found in the sugarcane field
physical_harm.reason: Death of the victim is established.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Charged with 2 offences (ss.302 and 376 IPC); both convictions set aside
number_of_offences.quote: the conviction and penalty are set aside
number_of_offences.reason: Convictions were set aside, so 'upheld' is wrong.

financial_property_loss.reason: No financial or property loss from the offence is stated; land dispute is only the defence claim.

premeditation_planning.quote: under the pretext of showing dance and song performances
premeditation_planning.reason: Court made no premeditation finding; the pretext is only narrated.

motive.reason: Prosecution motive is not identified; the land dispute is the defence's theory.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: None accepted; PWs 1 to 3 evidence held completely untrustworthy and last seen theory not established
key_evidence_accepted.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Supreme Court did not accept the circumstantial evidence or last seen theory; it rejected the evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: These contradictions make the evidence of PWs 1 to 3 completely untrustworthy.
witness_credibility.reason: Accurately reflects the court's finding on PWs 1 to 3.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Absconding when the body was found (per courts below)
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment records that the appellant was absconding when the body was found.

trial_duration.quote: Judgment and Order dated 18.04.2016 of the High Court
trial_duration.reason: 18.04.2016 is the High Court decision date, not the trial judgment; HC date marked 'Not stated' is wrong.

legal_representation.quote: S. Nagamuthu, Sr. Adv... Advs. for the Appellant; Ardhendumauli Kumar Prasad, AAG... Advs. for the Respondent
legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellant and State match the judgment's appearance list.

investigation_status.quote: documents submitted by the police, presumably along with the final report
investigation_status.reason: Final report/charge sheet filed, FIR registered, and trial completed.

procedural_irregularity.quote: Therefore, we hold that the delay of 5 days in transmitting the FIR to the jurisdictional court, especially in the facts and circumstances of this case was fatal.
procedural_irregularity.reason: Five-day FIR delay and failure to medically examine accused are the irregularities found fatal.

appeal_history.quote: the High Court confirmed the conviction and sentence
appeal_history.reason: Trial conviction and death sentence, HC confirmation, and SC allowance all match.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: PWs 1 to 3 evidence was cogent and trustworthy; FIR delay did not vitiate trial or prejudice accused; forensic/medical evidence not always mandatory
prosecution_argument.quote: that their evidence was found to be cogent and trustworthy by two Courts; that the delay in forwarding the FIR to the court did not vitiate the trial
prosecution_argument.reason: Summary omits the State's actual arguments on delay and forensic evidence, attributing court reasoning instead.

defence_argument.correct_value: PWs 1 to 3 untrustworthy due to contradictions; unexplained five-day FIR delay; I.O. failed to produce forensic/medical evidence; s.313 non-compliance; insufficient last seen evidence; material witnesses not examined
defence_argument.quote: that in a shocking abdication of duties, the I.O. failed to produce forensic/medical evidence
defence_argument.reason: Omits s.313 and last seen and missing-witness arguments; 'gaping hole' is the court's phrasing, not counsel's.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the chain of circumstances is complete and unbroken... exclude every possible hypothesis except the one to be proved
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the panchsheel principles applied for circumstantial evidence.

precedent_relied_upon.reason: All nine cases listed in the judgment's headnote are included.

sentencing_rationale.quote: one of the rarest of rare cases where a six year old girl had been raped and murdered
sentencing_rationale.reason: Accurately reflects lower courts' rarest of rare rationale and the SC overturning it.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court records no mitigating factors for sentencing.

judicial_aggravating_factors.correct_value: Ghastly and shocking nature of rape and murder of a six-year-old child
judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: It is a ghastly case of rape and murder of a 6 year old child.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Judgment describes the case as ghastly and shocking, an aggravating characterisation, so 'None' is wrong.

other_sentence_order.quote: The appellant shall be released forthwith if not wanted in connection with any other case.
